fields.label: Impact
fields.options:
Blocking my work
Painful but I can work around it
Nice to have
fields.default: Painful but I can work around it
fields.description: The requester's own assessment. Deliberately not called Priority: it is an input to triage, not the priority of the work, and the generated Tasks carry their own.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Submitted
Approved
Breakdown Ready
Breakdown Failed
Tasks Created
Rejected
Duplicate
fields.description: The transition table lives in product_feedback/states.py and is enforced in validate(). The worker writes some transitions with db.set_value, which skips validate() — so the controller check is the backstop for desk and console edits, not the enforcement point.

fields.label: Requested By
fields.description: Always frappe.session.user at submit time. A `requested_by` in the client payload is dropped, not honoured.

fields.label: Steps to Reproduce
fields.description: Bugs only. A bug report without these costs a round trip that the reporter has already forgotten the answer to.

fields.label: Page URL
fields.description: Captured by the SPA from the page the requester came from. Client-supplied and therefore untrusted: displayed as text, never followed and never used in a query.

fields.label: DocType
fields.description: Data, not a Link. The string arrives from a browser and a Link would make it a foreign key on a value nobody validated — and the doctype may have been renamed or removed since.

fields.label: App Version
fields.description: The deploy version the requester was running. Answers 'is this already fixed?' before anyone opens the code.

fields.label: Decision Reason
fields.description: Mandatory on a rejection and shown to the requester. A rejection with no reason reads as being ignored, and the same request arrives again next month.

fields.label: Targets ERPNext
fields.description: Proposed by the model at approval time and overridable by the reviewer before the breakdown runs. Which Project this means is Product Feedback Settings.erpnext_project, not a hard-coded id.

fields.label: Duplicate Of
fields.description: Set when the reviewer closes the request against an existing Task instead of creating new ones.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: The model's one-paragraph reading of the request. Shown above the proposal so a reviewer can spot a misunderstanding without reading every row.

fields.label: Breakdown Requested At
fields.description: Stamped when the job is enqueued, not when it returns. The hourly sweeper uses it to find requests whose job the deploy FLUSHDB destroyed.

fields.label: Proposed Tasks
fields.description: Nothing here has been written to a Project. The reviewer edits these rows and the confirm call is what creates the Tasks — see api/feedback.create_tasks.
